deviceId.description: pd- plus 8 lowercase hex digits from the nRF52840's factory ID.

ownerSub.description: Cognito user ID (the token's sub claim).

ts.description: Milliseconds since 1970. The 2020 minimum rejects a seconds value by mistake.

mode.description: auto: the node runs its own rules. manual: the LED follows commands.

cmdId.description: c- plus 8 random base-36 characters, made by the Lambda. The node echoes it back as ack.

pigHours.description: Door nodes only. Phoenix time, 24-hour HH:MM; may cross midnight (23:00 to 05:00). The Lambda also rejects start == end.

source.description: live: sent on the state topic. recovered: held by the gateway during an outage.
